_comment: Tier-2 for sparta conjugate_heat_transfer, ambipolar_plasma and adaptive_grid: three setup-time traps, two loud and one silent. Five decks were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial). conjugate_heat_transfer:5 — the SAME deck was run twice, once with ar.species and ar.vss copied into the working directory and once with nothing copied; staged it exits 0, unstaged it prints 'ERROR on proc 0: Cannot open species file ar.species (../particle.cpp:711)'. Running the pair is what makes that message evidence for the cwd claim rather than evidence that some deck somewhere fails. ambipolar_plasma:4 — the same deck was run with two surf_react prob files differing only in one probability value; 1.5 gives 'ERROR: Surface reaction probability for a species > 1.0 (../surf_react_prob.cpp:287)' with no stats row at all, so the validation is at READ time, and 0.5 runs. adaptive_grid:5 — 'balance_grid rcb cell' and 'balance_grid rcb part' on a serial build both print exactly 'Balance grid migrated 0 cells' and the run continues to completion, so a zero there is not an error report and balance_grid is not a remedy for a load imbalance inside one rank. No measured number is pinned. COVERS: conjugate_heat_transfer:5, ambipolar_plasma:4, adaptive_grid:5. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 STAGES the species files into the working directory of the run that is supposed to be missing them, so both halves of the staging pair are the identical deck with identical inputs; species_file_not_staged goes from rc!=0 with the Cannot-open-species-file abort to rc=0 n_errors=0. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: species_file_not_staged_message=ERROR on proc 0: Cannot open species file ar.species (../particle.cpp:711), every_quoted_setup_message_is_verbatim=True, the_same_deck_runs_when_the_species_file_is_staged=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/staging_balance_and_reaction_file_setup_traps && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line.
